messages:
anya: Heads-up — billing noticed extra charge attribution to org-default project after some teams used the impersonation flow. Proposal: add a tiny 'token lineage' widget in Console that shows origin, proxies/steps, impersonations, and the final routed project so we can triage quota/billing quickly.

kevin: widget sounds useful. technical suggestion: canonical signed header `x-rwinf-provenance` emitted by trusted proxies. payload includes version, proxy id, ordered steps. Example (compact): `x-rwinf-provenance: v=1;sig=MEU...;p=orig:api-key|via:proxy-a|imp:sa-logs@proj-infra|route:proj-payments` to prevent spoofing.

molly: must have privacy controls. orgs should choose hashed ids by default and allow readable labels only for org admins. retention and redaction settings required.

devon: legacy/third-party proxies won't emit header. we can mark provenance as `inferred` when reconstructed from mTLS certs / request headers, but that reduces trust. UI should surface verified vs inferred.

matt: hosted proxies sign by default. for private/on-prem customers allow uploading verification public keys or HSM-backed signing. add config knob: `provenance.policy = signed|inferred|disabled`.

kevin: telemetry ingestion plan: low-latency per-org index for the Console widget and a daily batch rollup for billing. schema (ingest-level): fingerprint, verified=true/false, provenance_mode, route_rule_id, org_hash, project_hash, impersonator_hash, timestamp. default to hashing ids; plaintext only if org opts in.

anya: UX notes: heatmap should be click-to-expand into a timeline view showing the sequence of steps and which routing rule produced the final project. provide an action to re-run attribution for selected events (useful for correcting billing).

devon: also surface recent routing policy changes in the same view (lookback 24h) to help explain spikes. add a canary preview to simulate how a rollback would reassign attribution.

sre-bot: Incident created: #2419 "unexpected billing attribution". Linking this thread.

molly: action items: kevin + matt draft header spec and telemetry fields; anya + devon mock Console widget and admin gating; ops schedule canary. i'll open a spike ticket and assign owners. keep spike minimal.

ops-bot: Canary cluster scheduled for test on 2024-10-03T22:00:00Z (auto-created).

kevin: i'll post an example JSON schema in the RFC PR later today.

matt: prototype header payload we validated with the signing lib (example JSON for clarity): ```{"v":"1","steps":[{"type":"orig","id":"api-key:abc"},{"type":"via","id":"proxy-a"},{"type":"imp","id":"sa-logs@proj-infra"},{"type":"route","id":"proj-payments"}],"sig":"MEU..."}``` verified via proxy pubkey.

molly: great — thanks everyone. small scope for the spike and iterate. :rocket:
